value.0: Sit, citizen. The throne is comfortable enough. Five questions on the things in your power and the things not. Answer plainly.
Acceptable. When you sleep, I will read with you. Memento mori.
You confuse what is yours with what is the world's. Sit longer with that.
You remember what is in your power, and you act on it, <FullName>. Memento mori. The work continues — but the test is done.
